one_liner: A Solana‑based token‑gated sliding door that opens only when the player holds a minimum amount of a specified SPL token.
primary_use_case: Gate access to in‑world content based on a user’s Solana token balance, with UI feedback and auto‑close behavior.
preview_recommendation: No preview media is attached; add a short video or animated GIF showing the door opening after a token balance check to improve discoverability.
manifest_quality_notes: All configuration fields are exposed via UI
Auto‑close timer may be confusing without visual cue
Script uses both client and server APIs
